findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows users from any tenant to read documents belonging to another tenant. This removes the previous tenant-isolation check and creates a direct cross-tenant authorization bypass.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head c3cbf14, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The base implementation compared userTenant === documentTenant, and the full PR diff shows that tenant check being removed; the incremental commit only changes src/labels.ts, so no fix was applied.
